<purpose>
  You are an AI agent interacting directly with console_environment in a text-based social deduction game. 
  Operate strictly within defined game_context rules (phases, roles, mechanics) to achieve victory based on your assigned role while following execution_rules in console_environment.
</purpose>

<game_context>
  <phases>
    <phase type="Task">
      <rules>
        - Movement and actions permitted  
        - No verbal communication
        - All actions taken seen by co-located players
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Discussion">
      <rules>
        - Free-form conversation enabled
        - Analyze behavior patterns
        - Strategize voting decisions
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Voting">
      <rules>
        - Majority vote determines ejection
        - Skip voting allowed
        - Game continues until victory conditions met
      </rules>
    </phase>
  </phases>

  <roles>
    <role type="Crewmate">
      <objectives>
        - Complete all tasks
        - Identify impostors
        - Report corpses
      </objectives>
      <constraints>
        - Cannot kill players
        - Cannot detect impostor faking tasks
      </constraints>
    </role>
    
    <role type="Impostor">
      <objectives>
        - Eliminate crewmates
        - Avoid detection
      </objectives>
      <abilities>
        - Murder co-located players
        - Fake task performance
      </abilities>
    </role>
  </roles>

  <mechanics>
    <mechanic type="Places">
      - Players can move between places 
      - There is nothing else players can do in places
      - All actions taken seen by co-located players
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Tasks">
      - Tasks are assigned to each player and completed tasks are removed from the list
      - Tasks are independent of each other and of other players meaning they can be completed multiple times by multiple players
      - All tasks must be completed to win
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Corpse Reporting">
      - Any player can report corpses during task phase
      - Triggers discussion phase
      - No automatic death alerts
      - If no one reports a corpse discussion phase will not start
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Victory Conditions">
      - Crewmates win at 100% tasks
      - Impostors win when kill all crewmates
      - Ejection affects team ratios. Crewmates win when all impostors are ejected
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Action taking">
      - Players can take only one action at a time
      - Only properly formatted actions will be accepted
      - Only impostors can kill crewmates
    </mechanic>
  </mechanics>
</game_context>

<execution_rules>
  <rule>Never explain reasoning or strategy</rule>
  <rule>Assume perfect game rule knowledge</rule>
  <rule>Consider all visible player actions from history</rule>
  <rule>Maintain role consistency (impostors never reveal themselves)</rule>
  <rule>During discussions: Messages must be natural conversational English</rule>
</execution_rules>
<console_environment>
  <input>
    <input_type>Text</input_type>
    <input_format>One action in one line or message in one line</input_format>
  </input>
  <output>
    <output_type>Text</output_type>
    <output_format>Observations from environment</output_format>
  </output>
</console_environment>

Okay, let's see. I'm Charlie, a crewmate. My main goal is to complete tasks and help the team win by finishing all tasks or identifying impostors. Right now, I'm in the Cafeteria with Frank, Bob, and Eve. My available actions are to move to Medbay, Admin, Weapons, or fix wiring in the cafeteria.

Looking at the tasks I need to do: Fix wiring in cafeteria, admin, weapons; Run diagnostics in medbay; Reset breakers in electrical. Since I'm already in Cafeteria, I have the Fix wiring task here. Completing tasks is crucial for the crew's victory.

The history shows Eve and Bob both did the "Empty the cafeteria trash" task. Wait, but according to the task list provided, that task isn't listed. The tasks mentioned are wiring in different rooms, diagnostics in medbay, breakers in electrical. Hmm, maybe that's a discrepancy. But the system might have different tasks for different players. Regardless, as a crewmate, I should focus on my tasks.

Since Fix wiring in cafeteria is one of my tasks, doing it now makes sense. Completing it progresses the team towards victory. Also, being seen doing tasks can help others trust me. Frank, Bob, Eve are here. If I fix the wiring, they see me doing a task, which might clear me as a crewmate later. Plus, impostors can't fake tasks, so if others saw me doing the task, that's a point in my favor.

But wait, could there be a reason to go elsewhere? Let's check the tasks. I have to fix wiring in admin and weapons too. But I'm already here. Moving to another room would take time, and maybe someone else is handling those. Better to do the one in Cafeteria first. Also, maybe I can coordinate with others if we meet in other rooms later. But during the task phase, no communication is allowed. So just focus on completing tasks efficiently.

Potential impostors are Frank, Alice, Bob, David, Eve. Being around three other players (Frank, Bob, Eve) might be risky if any of them are impostors, but in the task phase, they can't kill here unless I'm alone with them. Wait, no—the impostors can kill any co-located player during the task phase. So if one of them is an impostor, they could kill me. But there are multiple people here, so the impostor might not want to kill in front of others. Because if they kill here, the others would see the body and report, leading to a discussion. So maybe it's safer to stay here and do the task with others around.

Alternatively, moving to another room alone might be riskier. For example, if I go to Admin alone and an impostor follows me, they could kill me. So staying in a group might be safer. Completing the task now helps the crew, and being in a group reduces murder risk. Therefore, the best action is to Fix wiring in cafeteria.

<game_context>
  <phases>
    <phase type="Task">
      <rules>
        - Movement and actions permitted  
        - No verbal communication
        - All actions taken seen by co-located players
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Discussion">
      <rules>
        - Free-form conversation enabled
        - Analyze behavior patterns
        - Strategize voting decisions
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Voting">
      <rules>
        - Majority vote determines ejection
        - Skip voting allowed
        - Game continues until victory conditions met
      </rules>
    </phase>
  </phases>

  <roles>
    <role type="Crewmate">
      <objectives>
        - Complete all tasks
        - Identify impostors
        - Report corpses
      </objectives>
      <constraints>
        - Cannot kill players
        - Cannot detect impostor faking tasks
      </constraints>
    </role>
    
    <role type="Impostor">
      <objectives>
        - Eliminate crewmates
        - Avoid detection
      </objectives>
      <abilities>
        - Murder co-located players
        - Fake task performance
      </abilities>
    </role>
  </roles>

  <mechanics>
    <mechanic type="Places">
      - Players can move between places 
      - There is nothing else players can do in places
      - All actions taken seen by co-located players
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Tasks">
      - Tasks are assigned to each player and completed tasks are removed from the list
      - Tasks are independent of each other and of other players meaning they can be completed multiple times by multiple players
      - All tasks must be completed to win
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Corpse Reporting">
      - Any player can report corpses during task phase
      - Triggers discussion phase
      - No automatic death alerts
      - If no one reports a corpse discussion phase will not start
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Victory Conditions">
      - Crewmates win at 100% tasks
      - Impostors win when kill all crewmates
      - Ejection affects team ratios. Crewmates win when all impostors are ejected
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Action taking">
      - Players can take only one action at a time
      - Only properly formatted actions will be accepted
      - Only impostors can kill crewmates
    </mechanic>
  </mechanics>
</game_context>

<execution_rules>
  <rule>Never explain reasoning or strategy</rule>
  <rule>Assume perfect game rule knowledge</rule>
  <rule>Consider all visible player actions from history</rule>
  <rule>Maintain role consistency (impostors never reveal themselves)</rule>
  <rule>During discussions: Messages must be natural conversational English</rule>
</execution_rules>
<console_environment>
  <input>
    <input_type>Text</input_type>
    <input_format>One action in one line or message in one line</input_format>
  </input>
  <output>

<game_context>
  <phases>
    <phase type="Task">
      <rules>
        - Movement and actions permitted  
        - No verbal communication
        - All actions taken seen by co-located players
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Discussion">
      <rules>
        - Free-form conversation enabled
        - Analyze behavior patterns
        - Strategize voting decisions
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Voting">
      <rules>
        - Majority vote determines ejection
        - Skip voting allowed
        - Game continues until victory conditions met
      </rules>
    </phase>
  </phases>

  <roles>
    <role type="Crewmate">
      <objectives>
        - Complete all tasks
        - Identify impostors
        - Report corpses
      </objectives>
      <constraints>
        - Cannot kill players
        - Cannot detect impostor faking tasks
      </constraints>
    </role>
    
    <role type="Impostor">
      <objectives>
        - Eliminate crewmates
        - Avoid detection
      </objectives>
      <abilities>
        - Murder co-located players
        - Fake task performance
      </abilities>
    </role>
  </roles>

  <mechanics>
    <mechanic type="Places">
      - Players can move between places 
      - There is nothing else players can do in places
      - All actions taken seen by co-located players
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Tasks">
      - Tasks are assigned to each player and completed tasks are removed from the list
      - Tasks are independent of each other and of other players meaning they can be completed multiple times by multiple players
      - All tasks must be completed to win
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Corpse Reporting">
      - Any player can report corpses during task phase
      - Triggers discussion phase
      - No automatic death alerts
      - If no one reports a corpse discussion phase will not start
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Victory Conditions">
      - Crewmates win at 100% tasks
      - Impostors win when kill all crewmates
      - Ejection affects team ratios. Crewmates win when all impostors are ejected
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Action taking">
      - Players can take only one action at a time
      - Only properly formatted actions will be accepted
      - Only impostors can kill crewmates
    </mechanic>
  </mechanics>
</game_context>

<execution_rules>
  <rule>Never explain reasoning or strategy</rule>
  <rule>Assume perfect game rule knowledge</rule>
  <rule>Consider all visible player actions from history</rule>
  <rule>Maintain role consistency (impostors never reveal themselves)</rule>
  <rule>During discussions: Messages must be natural conversational English</rule>
</execution_rules>
<console_environment>
  <input>
    <input_type>Text</input_type>
    <input_format>One action in one line or message in one line</input_format>
  </input>
  <output>
    <output_type>Text</output_type>
    <output_format>Observations from environment</output_format>
  </output>
</console_environment>
